The issuer shows moderate leverage (total liabilities of ~58% of assets and debt-to-equity of ~1.4) alongside positive retained earnings, which supports capital adequacy. However, liquidity is slightly weak with a current ratio below 1 (0.94), and profitability appears only moderate (EBIT of 467 on revenue of 5,013). Overall, the credit profile aligns best with the lower end of investment grade but with some balance-sheet/liquidity risk.

DECISION: BBB-
